entries.summary: Bertold von Zwingenberg verpflichtet sich, wieder im Schloß Lichteneck bei Ingelfingen sich zu stellen; Siegel: Bertold von Zwingenberg und Eberhard von Rosenberg (Duplikat).
entries.german:
Ich Berhtolt von Zwingenberg ein edel knecht bekenne offenlich an disem briefe vnd tun kunt allen den die in sehent
oder horent lesen / daz ich gevangen bin mines herren / hern Kraften von Hohenlach dez alten / vnd sin erben / vnd vmb die
gevenknisse [?] hat er mir tag gebin / biz uf den wissen suntag der nehst kumpt / daz ich mich sal stellen / den Lichtenecke [?]
vnd daz es nummer ze komen / ich sie dan behalten vor in den banden / da ich vor inne bin gewesen on alle gnade / vnd auch
nit ledig ze sin ez si dane sin wile vnd sin wort / oder sin erben sach [?] ist mere gered [?] / wes daz man min herre be
dorfte her Kraft von Hohenlach der vorgenant / so hat er mich gemanet in Eberhartes hus von Rosinberg / dez sol [?] ich
han [?] wan er die manunge tet [?] mit sinen briuen oder mit sinen boten / so sol ich mich dar nach stellen in virzehen [?]
tagen den Lichtenecke [?] / in alle wise als vorgeschriben stet / on alle gnade / vnd han dez zu den heyligen gesworn
stet ze halten an alle gnade / ze vrkunde vnd sicherheit aller vorgeschribener rede / han ich min eygen Insigel
gehenket an disen brief / vnd zu einer besern gezugnisse han ich gebetten hern Wiprechten von Dürn daz er
sin Insigel zu min hat gehenket an disen brief / Ich Wiprecht von Dürn vorgenant bekenne daz ich durch
bette willen dez vorgenanten Berhtolts von Zwingenberg / min Insigel zu sinem han gehenket an disen brief / der
geben wart do man zalt von Cristes geburte / drizehenhundert iar / vnd dar nach in dem fünf vnd sechzigsten
iare an dem nehsten Samstage vor sant Gregorien tag
entries.english:
I, Berthold von Zwingenberg, Edelknecht, publicly declare in this letter and make known to all who see
or hear it read that I am a prisoner of my lord, Lord Kraft von Hohenlohe the Elder, and his heirs, and concerning the
imprisonment [?] he has given me a term until the coming White Sunday, by which I shall present myself at Lichteneck [?]
and that it never come [?] to pass, unless I am kept in the bonds in which I was before, without mercy, and also
not to be released, unless it be his will and his word, or his heirs [?] … whatever my lord needs [?]
the aforesaid Lord Kraft von Hohenlohe, then he has summoned me to the house of Eberhard von Rosenberg, this shall I [?]
have [?] when he makes [?] the summons with his letters or with his messengers, then I shall present myself thereafter within fourteen [?]
days at Lichteneck [?], in every way as written above, without mercy, and I have sworn this on the saints
to keep without mercy. In witness and assurance of all the aforesaid, I have attached my own seal
to this letter, and for better testimony I have asked Lord Wiprecht von Dürn that he
have attached his seal to mine to this letter. I, the aforesaid Wiprecht von Dürn, declare that, at the
request of the aforesaid Berthold von Zwingenberg, I have attached my seal to his to this letter. This was
given when one counted from Christ’s birth thirteen hundred years and thereafter in the sixty-fifth year, on the next Saturday before St. Gregory’s day.

facts.content: was held prisoner by Kraft von Hohenlohe the Elder and his heirs and was not to be released without their will and word.
undertook to present himself at Lichteneck [?] by the coming Weißer Sonntag and, when summoned by Kraft von Hohenlohe, within fourteen days [?].
swore on the saints to keep his undertaking and sealed it.
had his house named as the place where Kraft von Hohenlohe could summon Berthold von Zwingenberg.
sealed Berthold von Zwingenberg’s undertaking at his request.
